label: Bible Study
prompt: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy _____, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
verse: But thou, when thou prayest, enter into thy closet, and when thou hast shut thy door, pray to thy Father which is in secret; and thy Father which seeth in secret shall reward thee openly.
note: Jesus' prayer advice — shut the door; the Father sees what's done in secret.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual _____, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
verse: Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
note: Paul's picture of a Spirit-filled life sounds like choir practice: psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And many spread their _____ in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
verse: And many spread their garments in the way: and others cut down branches off the trees, and strawed them in the way.
note: The crowd paved the road with their own garments and cut branches — a red carpet, Jerusalem style.

label: Deep Water
prompt: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be _____ therefore, and repent.
verse: As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent.
note: Jesus to lukewarm Laodicea: the rebuke is love, and the cure for tepid is zeal.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: It is better to dwell in a corner of the _____, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
verse: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
note: Better a corner of the 'housetop' than a wide house with a brawling woman — Proverbs liked it enough to say it twice (25:24).
